- Deletion is irreversible: artifacts, workspace membership, "},{"id":"p22s3","text":"and the live
entry are all removed. The session-projection cache may keep a harmless
stale row until"},{"id":"p22s4","text":" are all removed. The session-projection cache may keep a harmless
